title: Josiah Cleanses the Land and Finds the Book of the Law
description: King Josiah leads a thorough cleansing of Judah and Jerusalem from idolatry and sends workers to repair the temple. During the work, the priest Hilkiah finds the Book of the Law of the Lord. When the king hears its words, he tears his clothes and sends messengers to the prophetess Huldah. She proclaims that disaster will come upon the place, but not in Josiah's lifetime because he humbled himself before God. The king gathers the people, reads from the Book of the Covenant, and renews the covenant with the Lord.
